title: Tree Spinach - 2x Mini Plug Plants  - Giant Spinach
description:
Grow your own vibrant, edible Giant Goosefoot with ease!


KEY FEATURES
• Vibrant magenta young leaves, perfect for eye-catching salads.
• Fast-growing annual, reaching up to 2-3 metres in height.
• Continuous harvest of tender, nutritious leaves.
• Easy to grow and low maintenance.
• Versatile in the kitchen: delicious raw or cooked.


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Herbs — Chenopodium giganteum
Colour: Green leaves with magenta new growth, tiny greenish-yellow flowers
Season: Summer (flowering)
Growth Habit: Upright, Bushy
Flavour: Similar to spinach and chard, with a slight hint of asparagus when cooked. Young leaves are tender.
Time to Harvest: 6-7 weeks after sowing (for first harvest)


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun, Partial shade
Soil: Fertile Loam, Clay, Chalk, Sand
Watering: Keep soil evenly moist, especially during dry spells. Tolerates some drought.
Spacing: 1.5 - 2 metres apart (if direct sowing, thin seedlings to 20cm apart)
Height: 2 - 3 metres
Spread: 0.45 - 2 metres
Hardiness: H5 (-10 to -15C)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out in late April to late July in a sunny or partially shaded spot with well-drained soil.
• Water regularly during dry periods; leaves may droop if thirsty.
• Mulch around the base to retain soil moisture and suppress weeds.
• Harvest young leaves and shoot tips regularly to encourage fresh growth and prevent premature flowering.
• Taller plants may benefit from staking in windy locations.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
